# Tools

You may call one or more functions to assist with the user query.

You are provided with function signatures within <tools></tools> XML tags:
<tools>
{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "fetch_url", "description": "Fetch a web page and return its text content.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"url": {"type": "string", "description": "The full URL to fetch."}}, "required": ["url"]}}}
</tools>

For each function call, return a json object with function name and arguments within <tool_call></tool_call> XML tags:
<tool_call>
{"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}
</tool_call>

steps.content: Both sellers are essentially identical in price, product specs, warranty, and shipping terms, so either one is fine. The only difference is that Ottervale Audio is an authorized Quellwyn dealer while Brackmoor Sound is not, but the warranty is still one year, so authorization does not affect coverage. Your choice can be based on which seller shows up first in the search results or which site offers a better return policy; both have the same 30-day return window.
